newsitem.title: UK: UK construction output unchanged in Q2 1996.
newsitem.headline: UK construction output unchanged in Q2 1996.

text.p: The volume of UK construction industry output was unchanged in the second quarter of 1996 compared with the first quarter, the Department of Environment said.
Second quarter total output was also unchanged compared to the second quarter of 1995.

However, private housing output increased for the first time in over a year, and was four percent higher in the second quarter compared with the previous quarter, But it was nine percent lower than in the same period a year earlier.
The total volume of new work in the second quarter was unchanged compared with the previous quarter but two percent lower compared with the same period in 1995.
The total volume of repair and maintenance work was also unchanged compared with the previous quarter and two percent higher compared with the same period a year earlier.
New work in the public housing sector in the latest quarter was nine percent higher than in the previous quarter but nine percent lower compared with the second quarter of 1995.
The seasonally adjusted number of employees in employment in July 1996 was one percent lower compared with April 1996 and one percent lower compared with July 1995.
Total employment, including the self-employed, in July 1996 was unchanged compared with April 1996 but one percent lower compared with July 1995.
